title: Inception
text: Inception is a science fiction heist film about a thief who steals secrets by entering people's dreams. A team plants an idea in a corporate heir's mind through layered dream levels. The spinning top totem leaves the ending ambiguous.

title: Arrival
text: Arrival follows a linguist recruited by the military to communicate with aliens whose ships appear across Earth. Learning their circular language changes how she perceives time. The film treats language as a way of reshaping thought.

title: Parasite
text: Parasite is a dark comedy thriller about a poor family that infiltrates a wealthy household by posing as skilled workers. Class tension builds from a basement secret toward a violent birthday gathering.

title: The city will not cool overnight
text: A newspaper column on a record heat wave. Asphalt holds the day's temperature after sunset. The writer argues that shade trees and night buses matter more than another cooling-center press release.

title: Who needs a library after six
text: The city cut weekday library hours. Students lose a quiet desk and a printer. The column says public rooms are infrastructure, not a luxury for people who already own a study.

title: A strike measured in missed shifts
text: Bus drivers walked out over unpaid overtime. Commuters describe two-hour crossings and lost restaurant shifts. The column asks why the city budget can fund a stadium before a contract.

title: Keeper
text: A short story about a lighthouse keeper who starts leaving the lamp unlit on foggy nights. Fishermen still find the rocks. He writes letters to a sister who never answers and counts ships that do not come.

title: Tuesday stall
text: A fruit seller in a covered market pretends not to notice a boy stealing oranges. Each Tuesday she leaves one bruised orange at the edge of the crate. Winter comes and the boy stops arriving.

title: Last seat
text: On a night train a woman recognizes the stranger opposite her from a wedding years ago. They do not speak. Stations pass like unused sentences. At dawn she leaves the scarf he forgot on the seat.

title: JWT authentication
text: JWT authentication allows a server to issue a signed token after login. The client sends the token on later requests. The server verifies the signature instead of storing session state. Expired tokens must be rejected.

title: Why documents are chunked
text: Embedding an entire document into one vector averages out its meaning. Retrieval works better when text is split into overlapping chunks so a search hit points at a paragraph, not a whole essay.

title: Qdrant payload indexes
text: Qdrant stores vectors and a JSON payload per point. Keyword indexes on documentId and source make filtered search cheap. Without a payload index a filter scans every point.

title: The Dream Machine
text: The Dream Machine is a sci-fi thriller about a studio that records and sells other people's dreams. A thief breaks in at night to steal the dreams of a corporate board and plants false memories to close a deal. The machine's red light blinks through the layered sleep states.

title: Contact Signal
text: Contact Signal follows an astronomer who joins a linguist to decode a repeating transmission from space. As she learns the alien alphabet, the team's understanding of time and causality begins to change. The film treats language as a key to a different physics.

title: The House on the Hill
text: The House on the Hill is a dark comedy about a hired driver who discovers a hidden room beneath his employer's mansion. Class resentment between the two families boils over at a disastrous birthday dinner. A secret in the walls drives the finale.

title: OAuth 2.0 authorization
text: OAuth 2.0 is an authorization framework. A client receives a signed token after the user consents, without ever seeing the password. The server may keep stateful sessions or issue short-lived stateless credentials, and tokens must be validated on every call.

title: HNSW approximate nearest neighbor
text: HNSW is an approximate nearest neighbor index over vectors. It keeps a layered graph of connections. Queries are fast but memory grows with edges. A lower ef parameter trades recall for speed, and a filter over payload fields can scan many points unless the field is indexed.

title: Sharding a vector database
text: Sharding a vector database across machines requires a partition key. Choosing the wrong key concentrates load on one shard. A payload filter that is not indexed forces a scan of every point on the shard.

title: Cookie-based sessions
text: With cookie-based sessions the server stores the session in a database and sends the browser only a small session id. On each request the browser sends the cookie back and the server looks up the stored state. The session ends when the server deletes the row.

title: Static API keys
text: An API key is a long static secret that a client puts in a request header. It identifies a machine account rather than a person and has no expiry or signature. Rotating a key means generating a new one and revoking the old.

title: SAML single sign-on
text: SAML exchanges an XML assertion between an identity provider and a service provider for enterprise single sign-on. The user authenticates once at the identity provider, which signs an assertion that the application trusts. It is common in corporate networks.

title: Nightwalk
text: Nightwalk is a film about a lucid dreamer who learns to steer his own nightmares to cure his insomnia. He leaves a red door in every dream as a marker. The door begins to open on its own.

title: Signal to the Stars
text: Signal to the Stars is a film where a mathematician detects a repeating burst of prime numbers from space. She helps build a machine to travel to the source, but the journey changes what she knows about causality.

title: Two Families
text: Two Families is a dark comedy about two households sharing a duplex, one upstairs and one downstairs. A slow leak in the shared pipe turns small grievances into a feud. The final scene floods the staircase.

title: Scalar quantization
text: Scalar quantization compresses vectors to 8-bit integers to cut memory and speed up search. It loses some precision, so recall drops slightly. A quantile threshold keeps the most common values accurate.

title: Embedding similarity
text: An embedding model maps a text to a fixed-size vector. Similarity between two vectors is measured with cosine distance. Models trained for retrieval place related meanings close together.

title: Rent rises faster than wages
text: A city column on rent control. Landlords raise rents faster than wages and tenants move farther out. The writer argues vacancy taxes would do more than another affordability study.

title: Meters and the empty main street
text: A column on parking meters. Rising meter rates and aggressive fines drive shoppers to malls outside the city. The writer says free evening parking would save the main street.

title: The lamp across the street
text: A short story about a woman who watches her neighbor's lamp switch on every evening. When the lamp stays dark for a week she climbs the stairs to knock. The door is answered by a stranger.

title: The autumn dog
text: A short story about a lost dog that wanders back to an empty house every autumn. A new owner leaves the gate open and watches it cross the yard to sit on the old porch.
